description.en:
Gives a character a slot in the movement manager, or returns the slot it already has. Character moves and turns are run by a movement manager with 16 slots, one per character. CMND_CHR_POS_VAL_TRG, CMND_CHR_PATH_SETUP and the CMND_CHR_TURN_* commands take a free slot for the character when it has none. So calling this first is optional.
No shipped script calls it.

Slot number (0 to 15), or -1 if all 16 slots are taken.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Reserving a slot before moving a character (not found in script_clean/; invented)
